historical_guard_assessment: Preserve all 16 distinct input stocks and every original source, biological, assay and historical assertion. Fifteen descriptors are proposed for generic reference corrections: seven blocks and eight complete alternative sets. Index 14, Paraniabella yanshanensis NCBITaxon:577386 / source Niabella yanshanensis HAMBI 3031, remains unselected and byte-identical with native null/UNRESOLVED; a missing route is not taxon absence or a rationale to replace its valid NCBI label with an older name. The notes that the crosswalk was unavailable during earlier curation describe that historical action, not a present manual hold; preserve them. Reference routes do not reproduce the source's WGS-derived 16S mapping or identify individual stock assemblies. Keep the 16-day/eight-cycle input experiment distinct from endpoint persistence, OD-scaled abundance from viable counts, and controlled carbon-dependent outcomes from selective trait/pH mediation or alternative stable states. The prior batch50 self-adversarial assessment and all open discussions remain immutable; this is not a full scientific review. Preserve Hanford/C6 current biological predicates and literal ledger/cache facts. Later strict admission may project only HAMBI's admitted predecessor for its old digest/last-LLM checks, composing with the separately reviewed C6 successor when integrated rather than reverting it.
